title: Polymarket hourly Bitcoin prediction markets
description: A record from the hourly Polymarket Bitcoin prediction-market dataset, combining market observations, Binance BTCUSDT prices, and best bid and ask order-book prices.

items.title: Bitcoin prediction-market observation
items.description: One order-book state for one Polymarket asset at an observation time.

calendar_date.title: Calendar date
calendar_date.description: Trading date in ISO 8601 date format.

market_hour_id.title: Market hour ID
market_hour_id.description: Identifier of the hourly prediction market.

hour_start.title: Hour start
hour_start.description: Start of the market hour in UTC.

hour_end.title: Hour end
hour_end.description: End of the market hour in UTC.

price.title: Price
price.description: BTCUSDT price provided by the configured price source.

best_bid.title: Best bid
best_bid.description: Best available bid price, or null when unavailable.

best_ask.title: Best ask
best_ask.description: Best available ask price, or null when unavailable.

bid_levels.title: Bid levels
bid_levels.description: Detailed bid levels. This release stores null because individual levels are not included.

ask_levels.title: Ask levels
ask_levels.description: Detailed ask levels. This release stores null because individual levels are not included.
